response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine distributed/high-throughput systems experience (Dunnhumby's micro-services handling millions of requests/sec) and is currently hands-on with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq, which aligns well with the role's AI-native mindset. However, Python is completely absent from his skills list despite being an explicit must-have, and his resume shows a broad generalist trajectory across many stacks and short stints rather than deep, sustained ownership of large-scale distributed systems at Staff scope. There's also no explicit evidence of stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, or agile ceremony experience.
strengths: Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling
Prior experience building low-latency, high-throughput micro-services handling millions of requests/sec
Long, diverse technical career (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth and open-source leadership
concerns: No Python listed anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being a stated must-have
Career shows a generalist, jack-of-all-trades pattern (web, mobile, embedded, CMS) rather than deep specialization in distributed systems architecture
No explicit evidence of stakeholder management, on-call/incident response ownership, or agile ceremony participation (e.g., scrum champion)

key_factors.factor: Generalist career breadth vs. deep distributed-systems specialization
